title: Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-fleet: fleet is failing in ultrastable/ultrastable
body:

**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/ultrastable fleet
**Status:** closed

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-19T09:20:53Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (already built: the probe passed from filing and held for 37 passes over 1440 minutes (VACUOUS-CLOSE-1)): exit 0


**Relapse:** 2026-11-23T02:11:03Z closing probe failed again: exit 1 (reopen 1; closes again only after 2 passes over 60 minutes)

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-23T02:11:22Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 89.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
